nurse.text: Good day, and welcome to Edinburgh Sanctuary. It's the nicest Sanctuary in the world, in a city that has several nice things. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Take a seat. Have a shortbread, a wee dram of tea, whatever you fancy. Don't mind the wind. It likes to rearrange us.
All done, and in excellent form! Mòran taing for waiting. Dùn Èideann is lovely, but it's a lot of hills for a tired team.
The Ark terminal. It's in the cellar, which is where every self-respecting Edinburgh object lives.

else.text: Right you are. Beannachd leibh, and mind the cobbles: they're older than the streets.
